# `state/worldmodel/ObjectGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/worldmodel/ObjectGraph.js`

state/worldmodel/ObjectGraph.js — object identity + relationship graph (spec §15 "Object identity graph" + "Spatial and relationship graph").  Tracks objects with STABLE logical ids (independent of their content version) and typed directed relations between them: inside, near, connected-to, blocks, contains, reachable-from, visible-from, depends-on. Relations support reachability queries (e.g. "is room A reachable from room B over `connected`?") which the planner uses without ever asserting canonical truth.
